# 🧮 Emission Factor Change Checklist

- [ ] Source is primary and identifiable.
- [ ] Publication date and data vintage are recorded.
- [ ] Geography matches the intended use.
- [ ] Numerator and denominator are explicit.
- [ ] Unit conversions are independently checked.
- [ ] System boundary and included gases are stated.
- [ ] Allocation and activity assumptions are documented.
- [ ] Uncertainty and exclusions are described.
- [ ] License permits reuse and attribution is included.
- [ ] A second reviewer has assessed the factor.
- [ ] Independent worked examples are added.
- [ ] Automated tests are updated.
- [ ] UI, methodology guide, assumptions register, and changelog are updated.
